people.name: Elkanah
people.line: The father of the prophet Samuel.

translations.web: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
translations.bsb: Then Elkanah and all his house went up to make the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow,
translations.kjv: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
translations.asv: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Jehovah the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
